Name: Chest Displays
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
[size=5][b]About : 
[/b][/size]This is just a small mod to display the first or a selected item on top of your chest to allow for better organization.
It will choose the first item in your chest unless 1 is selected.
To select an item just hold the item in your hand and press Quote ( " ).
If you then want to change this to re-select the first item, just remove the selected item from the chest.
Works for both standard and stone chests.

[size=5][b]How to install : [/b]
[/size]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip file and place in the mod folder

[size=5][b]Update 1.1.0 :
[/b][/size]
[size=2]Added a config option to keep the item displayed even when it's removed from the chest.
[/size][size=2]this currently only works for all chests, I'm still working on improving this.
[/size]Also added an option to display the item's quality (kind of buggy but still....)

[b][size=5]Update 1.2.0 :
[/size][/b]
Added support for controllers
Items are now saved via a custom menu (accessed by pressing the selected button while standing in front of the chest)
Improved drawing for all objects (less flicker and slightly improved positioning)
Mod now allows all items to be saved (full support for modded items is not guaranteed)
Re-wrote save system
Added support for colored items (like roe)

[size=4][b]Also : [/b]
[/size]This mod uses harmony, harmony is prone to giving errors without many details, if something is to happen please send over a log file and it will be dealt with swiftly.
